pbo_caveat: Four leave-one-chronological-fold-out selections are not CSCV, depend on ambiguous fold cost boundaries, and have no promotion authority. With 0 failures in 4, the one-sided 95 percent binomial upper bound is about 0.527, above the 0.25 gate.

implementation_contract_findings.evidence: Entry cost appears in fold 1 and lifecycle liquidation cost only in fold 4. The manifest does not declare continuous-segment versus independent-fold accounting, invalidating positive-fold and PBO gate authority.
StrategySpec declares max_position_weight=0.4, while the manifest allows drift above 0.4 and several candidates report drifted maxima above that level.
D06 delays to 10:30 and filters target increases, reducing exposure and turnover. Its 0.219803 Sharpe difference from D04_same_intraday_window is not attributable to execution timing alone.
The paired path excludes D04's 2024-07-22 execution because that session is not intraday-complete, calls the remaining 29 dates exact, and starts from cash rather than carried D04 state.
PBO tie handling can pass an all-tied family, and 0/4 paths cannot establish PBO <= 0.25. N01 gates on an interpolated percentile rather than its computed plus-one Monte Carlo p-value.
Candidate parity uses max(SPY, equal-weight sectors), but this subset and exclusion rule are absent from the preregistered benchmark family contract.

The YAML entry and exit rules do not encode the custom core, satellite, sizing, schedule, or first-hour target logic. Generic promotion and execution backends would evaluate a different primary-symbol strategy.
Synthetic NaN input can silently disappear through pandas sum. Bound source loading rejects non-finite OHLCV, so stored-result impact was not demonstrated.

sample_data_caveats: The panels are real Alpaca Basic IEX snapshots through 2026-07-17, not fixtures.
IEX is a single-exchange feed without SIP, NBBO, or official-open parity.
The fixed current ETF universe is survivorship-labelled.
No real SEC, news, earnings, or call packet entered any candidate.
The formal-forward epoch starts 2026-07-20 and has zero observations.
capacity_assessment: Blocked without portfolio notional, consolidated ADV, auction volume, quotes, spreads, and matched fills.

economic_review.assessment: Aggregate values remain useful for auditing the frozen formulas, but no R7 candidate gate or promotion claim is valid.

notes: The original no-selection decision is retained. R7 must not be repaired in place or retuned; contract corrections belong to a separately preregistered iteration.
